hook.text: Your team spends 200 hours adjusting the statistical forecast. But the adjustments made it worse, not better.

buildup.text: Forecast value added (FVA) measures whether each step in the process actually improves forecast accuracy.

discovery.text: If a manual override makes the forecast less accurate, that step subtracts value and should be removed.

twist.text: Many companies discover that half their adjustments add no value. They're wasting expert time on noise.

climax.text: FVA analysis streamlines the process—keeping steps that add value and eliminating those that don't.

punchline.text: If a step doesn't improve the forecast, stop doing it.

quiz.question: What does forecast value added measure?
options: Whether each process step improves accuracy
